accuracyChecks.note: All checked answers were correct. Items checked by hand include interval algebra, three-set counting, vowels-together arrangements (MATHEMATICS, PLANET), binomial independent term, AM:GM ratio, foot of perpendicular, circle through three points, hyperbola through a point, step-deviation variance, grouped median and mean deviation, corrected SD, and addition-rule probability.
